fields.description: How many digits a cheque number is padded to, e.g. 6 gives 000101. Overridable per cheque book because banks differ.
fields.label: Default Padding Length

fields.description: Guard against a typo creating a book with thousands of leaves.
fields.label: Maximum Leaves Per Book

fields.description: Books larger than this generate their leaves in a background job instead of inline.
fields.label: Background Generation Threshold

fields.description: Require a reason code when voiding a cheque
fields.label: Require Void Reason

fields.description: Allow a voided cheque number to return to the unused pool. Off by default: a voided number should stay permanently traceable in the register. Turn it on only if you physically re-run misprinted leaves through the printer.
fields.label: Allow Void Leaf Reuse

fields.description: Mark a cheque Cleared when its voucher gets a clearance date, via Bank Clearance or the daily reconciler.
fields.label: Set Cleared From Clearance Date

fields.description: Reserve a leaf as soon as a draft voucher selects it, so two users cannot both draft against the same cheque.
fields.label: Reserve Leaf On Draft

fields.description: How many days ahead of its cheque date a received cheque is flagged as due.
fields.label: PDC Alert Days Before
